bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
WT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.worktrees/gaybbs-menu-20261115"
printf 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE='; docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115 --format '{{.Id}}'
printf 'LOCAL_IMAGE='; docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}'
printf 'ACTIVE_IMAGE='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}'
printf 'ACTIVE_RUNNING='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}'
printf 'COMPOSE_FILE='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}'
printf 'COMPOSE_WORKDIR='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}'
printf 'PRODUCTION_SECRETS='; for f in "$WT/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" "$WT/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt"; do if test -f "$f"; then echo present; else echo absent; fi; done
printf 'CODE_IN_ACTIVE='; if docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'grep -q "クリエイター投稿" /app/gaybbs.mjs'; then echo NEW; else echo OLD; fi
